card.name: Start of pharma- words
card.fires_on: The 'PH' or 'oph' piece that begins the 'pharm-' part of a word such as PHARMACOLOGY or Radiopharmaceuticals. It fires mostly in all-caps cross-references and in 'Radi-oph-armaceutical'.
